glosses: An agreement or arrangement between multiple parties to do something harmful, immoral or subversive; an instance of collusion.

examples.text: Conspiracies, like all other exercises of human ingenuity, are of very different kinds. The gloomy plots arranged in old Italian halls...

The Jacobins, the Bolsheviks and the Nazis all believed in vast conspiracies against them, as do radical Islamists today. It is never the flaws of human nature that stand in the way of Utopia. It is the workings of evil forces.

glosses: An agreement between two or more persons to break the law at some time in the future.
